content:
When Freda cooks canned tomatoes, they lose half their volume. This means the volume of sauce is half the volume of canned tomatoes used. The last batch made 32 ounces of sauce, so the volume of canned tomatoes used was 32 × 2 = 64 ounces.

Each can holds 16 ounces, so the number of cans used is 64 ÷ 16 = 4 cans.

Each can contains 3 tomatoes, so the total number of tomatoes used is 4 × 3 = 12.

Answer: 12
